sentences: The translator applies `mul:2`, `mul:4` or `div:2` to the median before clamping to [0, 1], following [LLVM’s modifier order](https://llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUModifierSyntax.html#omod).

The finite-input fixture `ps_med3_mods.asm` produced 4,096 exact pixels on an Apple M3 Max with MoltenVK and on Mesa llvmpipe (software Vulkan); it also passes (4,096/4,096) on an NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop and an AMD Radeon 740M (RADV), both Linux, and on an RTX 2060 SUPER per #634.
This uses the existing float MODE assumptions described above.
